hooks.command: claude --print "Review the conversation that just ended. Identify any new decisions, bug fixes, patterns, or learnings that should be persisted. For each one, append a concise note (1-3 lines) to the most relevant file in .claude/rules/. Format: '\n## [date] [topic]\n[what changed and why]'. Only write if there is something genuinely new. Do not restate existing content. Files: architecture.md, code-style.md, api.md, web3.md, rewards.md, referrals.md, smart-contracts.md, vaults.md, schema.md, deployments.md, security.md, agents.md, testing.md" --output-format text 2>/dev/null || true
